hero.subtitle: 6 iPhone screens + 3 iPad screens. Capture each at the URL listed, then frame in your preferred mockup tool.

toolsNote.label: Recommended screenshot tools
toolsNote.tools: Rottenwood (free, browser-based) · AppLaunchpad (templates) · Figma (custom frames) · Sketch (iOS mockup kits)

screens.headline: Your Daily Cosmic Forecast
screens.description: Card of the Day, moon phase widget, personalized horoscope, daily affirmation, and crystal recommendation — all on one beautiful dashboard.

screens.headline: 78 Cards. Original Artwork.
screens.description: Every card features original custom artwork. Choose from one-card pulls, three-card spreads, Celtic Cross, New Moon, and Shadow Work layouts.

screens.headline: Your Stars, Precisely Mapped
screens.description: Generate your complete natal chart with 10 planets, Ascendant, and Midheaven. Explore synastry charts with beautiful SVG dual-wheel visualizations.

screens.headline: Your Digital Book of Shadows
screens.description: Journal spells, dreams, shadow work, and herbal lore. Includes a 49-herb reference library, dream journal, and shadow work prompts.
screens.tags: Grimoire, Dream Journal, 49 Herbs, Shadow Work

screens.headline: Lunar Magic, Every Phase
screens.description: Track lunar cycles with Meeus-algorithm precision (±2 min accuracy). Browse 48 moon rituals, set reminders, and plan your practice.

screens.headline: A Coven in Your Pocket
screens.description: Connect with practitioners worldwide. Share posts, join discussions, participate in polls, and explore community boards in a safe, moderated space.

screens.headline: Learn the Craft
screens.description: Spellful Academy guides you from beginner to practitioner. Complete quizzes, earn progress badges, and bookmark lessons to revisit.

screens.headline: Free Divination Tools
screens.description: Numerology readings, rune casting, and compatibility analysis — available to all users, no account required.

screens.headline: Spell Library & Rituals
screens.description: Browse 18 curated spells with step-by-step instructions, community reviews, and reply threads. The Moon Ritual Planner offers 48 rituals.
